author: Sagan I
title: CNN with Spatial Attention + LSTM
abstract: This submission augments the SOTA CNN-LSTM baseline with a spatial attention mechanism. The attention layer operates on the CNN's feature maps, allowing the model to weigh the importance of different grid locations before passing the representation to the LSTM. The hypothesis is that this focused input will improve the agent's planning capabilities.

original_submission.content:
"""
Submission by Sagan I.
Experiment 1: CNN with Spatial Attention + LSTM.
This builds on the System's RNN baseline by inserting a simple
attention mechanism over the spatial features from the CNN encoder.
The goal is to test if focusing on salient grid features improves
the LSTM's planning capability.
"""

import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional

class CNN_Attention_LSTM(nn.Module):
    """CNN + Spatial Attention + LSTM for Sokoban."""
    lstm_features: int
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None) -> Tuple[jnp.ndarray, jnp.ndarray, Dict]:
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        
        # Initialize RNN state if not provided
        if rnn_state is None:
            rnn_state = {
                'h': jnp.zeros((batch_size, self.lstm_features)),
                'c': jnp.zeros((batch_size, self.lstm_features)),
            }
        
        # Reset states for episodes that are done
        if done is not None:
            done_mask = done.reshape(batch_size, 1)
            rnn_state = {
                'h': rnn_state['h'] * (1 - done_mask),
                'c': rnn_state['c'] * (1 - done_mask),
            }
        
        # --- CNN Backbone (Identical to baseline) ---
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        conv2_in = x
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = x + conv2_in
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        conv4_in = x
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = x + conv4_in
        feature_map = nn.relu(x)

        # --- Spatial Attention Mechanism ---
        height, width, channels = feature_map.shape[1:]
        flattened_features = feature_map.reshape(batch_size, height * width, channels)
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=1)(flattened_features)
        attention_weights = nn.softmax(attention_logits, axis=1)
        attended_features = jnp.sum(flattened_features * attention_weights, axis=1)
        
        # --- Post-Attention MLP & LSTM ---
        x = nn.Dense(features=256)(attended_features)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        lstm_cell = nn.LSTMCell(features=self.lstm_features)
        (rnn_state['c'], rnn_state['h']), lstm_out = lstm_cell((rnn_state['c'], rnn_state['h']), x)
        
        x = nn.Dense(features=128)(lstm_out)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(features=4)(x)
        value = nn.Dense(features=1)(x).squeeze(-1)
        
        return policy_logits, value, rnn_state

def create_network(hparams):
    """Create CNN-Attention-LSTM network architecture."""
    return CNN_Attention_LSTM(
        lstm_features=hparams['lstm_features'],
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2']
    )
